$comment: The acceptance test for primal/theme/tokenMap.ts. For each vibe: the fully resolved palette (seed + surfaces from vibe-tokens.json, plus the semantics the generator must synthesise and the mode slots tokenMap derives), and the exact theme output the map must produce from it. Both halves are checked by `node --experimental-strip-types primal/theme/tokenMap.ts --check`, which also re-verifies `colors`/`tokenColors` against the shipping theme files so this fixture cannot drift.
$semanticsAreTargets: palette.error/warning/info/added/deleted/modified/conflict are NOT inputs the generator gets for free - they are the values the shipping themes use, recorded here so the semantic synthesiser has a target. A synthesiser that reproduces them reproduces the shipping themes byte for byte.
